teaser: MeetScribe: Meet transcripts and a debrief on your own OpenRouter key, built in two hours from a reviewed brief, and a call for testers.
core_idea: Google Workspace Business Starter has no Meet recording or transcripts, and upgrading everyone doubles the bill. MeetScribe is a Chrome extension that transcribes the call you are in and writes a timed debrief, on your own OpenRouter key, with no bot, no Google recording and no server, for about 5 to 15 US cents an hour. It was built in about two hours from a ChatGPT brief that Claude reviewed first: 23 findings, four of which would have produced plausible but wrong transcripts. Consent is required in law in Portugal, so it asks users to tell everyone every meeting. It is a beta looking for testers.
